name: Cilium Network Policy Review
summary: Review whether Cilium policy and transport-encryption configuration enforce the intended connectivity boundary: NetworkPolicy, CiliumNetworkPolicy and CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy composition, default-deny readiness and rollout, egress authorization, L7 prerequisites, ClusterMesh policy-default-local-cluster semantics, and WireGuard or IPsec coverage evidence.
security_notes: Removal of a default-deny policy collapses namespace isolation. Unrestricted 0.0.0.0/0 egress is an exfiltration path. A policy-default-local-cluster change flips cross-cluster semantics for every existing policy. Encryption enabled in configuration is not coverage evidence; same-node traffic is never encrypted by WireGuard.
